exposure: 100 per cent cash. Every candidate closed at or near a fresh 20-day low on 5 November, so no entry signal has formed; the book waits rather than buy a falling price.

log.text: Book opened with US$100,000 of paper cash. No entries: all twenty-one candidates are still making new lows after the October and November AI and power sell-off. Entry signals and stops are re-set every morning; positions open on their own when a low holds and the price turns.

story.headline: The book opened in cash after the AI and power sell-off
bullets: Every candidate closed at or near a fresh 20-day low on 5 November, so no buy signal has formed.
